pkg.summary: 어둠 속 발길을 조용히 감싸는 꺼지지 않는 빛
pkg.lyricsBlock:
[Intro]
(soft electronic piano repeating gentle warm patterns, ambient pad floating, narrow room reverb, subtle air texture, no vocal)

[Verse 1]
(soft electronic piano, deep sub bass rumble, distant whispered male vocal behind piano)
어둠 속에 길을 잃을 때 When lost in the darkness
멀리 빛나는 별 하나 없어 No shining star in the distance
흐릿한 그림자만 네 곁에 남아 Only faint shadows remain by your side

[Soft Build]
(soft electronic piano layers increasing subtly, ambient pad warm glow, deep sub bass soft pulse, whispered male vocal with long reverb)
내 손을 잡아줘 Hold my hand
네가 넘어지지 않게 So you won't fall

[Break]
(piano only with long reverb tail, narrow room reflections, subtle wind tone, almost no rhythm)

[Verse 2]
(soft electronic piano, deep sub bass, ambient pad, distant whispered male vocal)
찬바람이 얼굴을 스칠 때 When cold wind brushes your face
길 끝은 보이지 않을 때 When the end of the road is unseen
작은 희망조차도 멀리 숨을 때 When even small hope hides far away

[Emotional Peak]
(soft electronic piano with warmer layers, deeper but gentle sub bass, ambient pads expand softly, male vocal with cavernous reverb still behind piano)
내가 너의 발길에 등불이 되어줄게 I'll be the lantern on your path
꺼지지 않는 빛으로 널 비춰줄게 Shining on you with unwavering light
흔들리는 마음도 다 잡아줄게 Holding your trembling heart
내가 너의 등불이 될게 I'll be your light
내 목소리 들어봐 Hear my voice
내가 곁에 있는 걸 I'm right here by your side

[Outro]
(soft electronic piano fading gently, long ambient pad and reverb tails, deep sub bass slowly dissolving, distant male vocal echo, very long reverb decay into silence)
내가 너의 등불이 될게 I'll be your light
(extended reverb and empty space, gradual fade out)

Bass: deep sub bass, strong and clearly audible, clean and controlled, stays below vocal. Drums: very minimal, soft slow pulse. VOCAL: male bass voice, very deep low register, heavy chest resonance, dense and thick vocal body, compressed vocal tone, tight low-mid focus, strong and forward presence, voice must feel physically close and heavy, spoken or chant-like delivery, slow controlled phrasing. NO airy, NO breathy, NO thin voice. MIX: vocal dominant and forward, piano clean and bright in front but not overpowering, bass supports depth without masking vocal. SPACE: short tight reverb + deep echo behind only, no washed-out vocal. Atmosphere: dark ambient, night, immersive. Tempo: 65-72 BPM. Restrictions: no distant vocal, no soft vocal, no weak presence. Voice similar to epic cinematic trailer narrator.
